Puff Puff是普吉岛芭东最棒的休闲胜地！位于Bangla路的这家店铺完美融合了大麻药房与咖啡馆功能，产品种类丰富品质一流。一楼周边商品精美，二楼休息室堪称惊艳：满墙沙发、PS5赛车模拟器、DJ台和空调房配备PS4/5，氛围感拉满。布朗尼甜点更是美味升级。员工服务堪称传奇，诚实友善得令人感动——有顾客遗落iPhone被店员追还。推广员Max和Homex热情周到，让人宾至如归。买二送一的优惠让价格更划算。无论是想从孟加拉路夜生活中喘息，还是寻找社交放松空间，这里都是绝佳选择。100%推荐！
reviews.text_en: Puff Puff is Patong's best relaxation spot in Phuket! Located on Bangla Road, this shop perfectly blends the functions of a cannabis dispensary and a cafe, offering a wide variety of high-quality products. The ground floor features exquisite merchandise, while the second-floor lounge is simply stunning: a wall of sofas, a PS5 racing simulator, a DJ booth, and an air-conditioned room equipped with a PS4/5, creating a fantastic atmosphere. The brownies are an upgraded treat. The staff service is legendary, honest and friendly to the point of being touching—a customer even lost their iPhone and had it returned by a staff member. Promoters Max and Homex are warm and attentive, making you feel right at home. The buy-two-get-one-free offer makes it even more affordable. Whether you're looking to escape the nightlife of Bangla Road or find a social and relaxing space, this is the perfect choice. 100% recommended!
